The science of sensation.
Polymers for cosmetics.

Cosmetics need high performance and more bio-sourced, biodegradable ingredients. Synboli develops tailored solutions for these needs.

Discuss this application

Polymers in
cosmetics.

Cosmetic formulations need performance alongside growing demand for bio-sourced and biodegradable ingredients. Synboli’s application examples cover film formation, sensory properties, emulsification and thickening, with different requirements for wear, stability and ingredient delivery.

Synboli enhances acrylate copolymers for hair hold, dimethicone derivatives for serum feel, and emulsifiers and thickeners for stable sunscreen formulations. Named examples include C10–30 acrylate crosspolymers and polyacrylamides.
